details: Base release of WMS 9.2 with the new wave planner.
Fixes to pallet label printing and handheld login timeouts.
Corrects wave size rounding and two cut-off calculation errors.
Security update for user session handling.
Cycle count screen fixes and batch picking performance improvements. This is the build running today.
Handheld scanner firmware compatibility and two cycle count screen fixes.
Security patch for API token handling and reworked wave planner timeouts.

Fixes the duplicate task issue (seen in v9.2.0 to 9.2.6). Also includes 3 minor fixes to batch picking and 1 security patch. Queue timeout logic changed: default 5 seconds, was 1 second. Test before deploying: (1) full PO receipt test with 50 concurrent receipts and verify no duplicate tasks; (2) batch picking with 1000+ item picks and verify performance under 2 seconds per pick; (3) user access check for permission regressions. Recommended deployment window: Saturday 02:00 to 06:00 (4 hours).
fixes_known_issue: KB-000002: duplicate replenishment tasks are created when two PO receipts arrive within 5 seconds. Workaround until patched: raise the event queue timeout from 1 second to 5 seconds in config.
